scope.summary: Implement the deterministic native raster-to-vector Image Trace primitive converting a placed raster into editable StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork geometry with the full option set (mode color/grayscale/black-and-white, palette + color/gray count or B/W threshold, paths fidelity, corners aggressiveness, noise minimum-area, method abutting/overlapping, fills/strokes/both, snap-curves-to-lines, ignore-white), plus make / make-and-expand / release / expand. This native trace MUST NOT require any provider or network; the generative vectorize is a separate optional lane (MT-136).
acceptance_criteria: deterministic native image trace with full options + make/expand/release; no provider/network; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: image trace panel reachable via author_id
test: deterministic trace with full option set produces editable geometry; make/make-and-expand/release/expand; runs with no provider/network

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Image Trace (raster to vector)

risk_if_missed: No native trace; raster-to-vector requires generative lane (spec violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
